verify.note: sim of the request, 180s, seed 1 (rogue worker, 2026-10-24)

summary: Combat Sinister Strike with a slow main hand axe and a slow off hand mace.
keyTalents: Hack and Slash 5/5 (axe extra attacks, mace off hand armor ignored)
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Adrenaline Rush under 39 energy while Slice and Dice is up
Blade Flurry on cooldown while Slice and Dice is up
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 5 combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6s left); spend leftover points in the last 3s
Sinister Strike right after a main-hand swing (0.5s), or at 79+ energy
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Eviscerate at 4 points loses 6 to 8 DPS.
Murder does nothing on the generic boss, so its points go to Lethality (Vile Poisons for Seal Fate Daggers).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18.
Assumed: the fight is in Hyjal or the Barrow Deeps. Its flask gives its full bonus only there.
10% hit (the wrist and the second ring carry 10 hit rating each): dual wielders take hit by sim (standards 4), and past the 8% yellow cap it still helps the white hits (+0.4 to +1.9 over 8%).
No Goblin Land Mine: its 1 sec cast resets the swing, and it doesn't gain here (standards 11, explosives only when they gain). The Sapper stays.
notes: Class default preset (default gear, talents, rotation, race and consumes); default for the Combat raid-sim preset.
